title.en: Special diodes: varactor, tunnel and Schottky
title.kn: ವಿಶೇಷ ಡಯೋಡ್‌ಗಳು: ವ್ಯಾರಾಕ್ಟರ್, ಟನೆಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಟ್ಕಿ

heading.en: Tuning a radio with a diode

hook.en: Old radios had a big tuning capacitor you turned by hand. A modern radio tunes with a tiny diode and a voltage. Let us meet the diodes with special jobs.
hook.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ರೇಡಿಯೋಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಯಿಂದ ತಿರುಗಿಸುವ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಟ್ಯೂನಿಂಗ್ ಧಾರಕ ಇತ್ತು. ಆಧುನಿಕ ರೇಡಿಯೋ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್‌ನಿಂದ ಟ್ಯೂನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the varactor diode and its use in tuning
Describe the tunnel diode and its negative resistance
State the features of a Schottky diode

narration.en: Old radios had a big tuning capacitor you turned by hand. A modern radio tunes with a tiny diode and a voltage. Let us meet the diodes with special jobs.
narration.kn: ಹಳೆಯ ರೇಡಿಯೋಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೈಯಿಂದ ತಿರುಗಿಸುವ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಟ್ಯೂನಿಂಗ್ ಧಾರಕ ಇತ್ತು. ಆಧುನಿಕ ರೇಡಿಯೋ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್‌ನಿಂದ ಟ್ಯೂನ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A reverse-biased junction stores charge like a capacitor: the p and n regions are the plates and the depletion layer is the dielectric. Increasing the reverse voltage widens the depletion layer, so the junction capacitance falls. For an abrupt junction $C = C_0/\sqrt{1 + V_R/V_0}$. A varactor is a diode made to use this effect; it replaces mechanical variable capacitors in electronic tuning of radio and TV receivers and in frequency-modulated oscillators.

narration.en: A varactor is a reverse-biased diode used as a capacitor. More reverse voltage widens the depletion layer and lowers the capacitance, which lets us tune circuits with a voltage.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯಾರಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಧಾರಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಬಯಾಸ್ ಡಯೋಡ್. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಸವಕಳಿ ಪದರವನ್ನು ಅಗಲಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಧಾರಕತೆಯನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ; ಇದರಿಂದ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್‌ನಿಂದ ಟ್ಯೂನ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

title.en: Varactor: a capacitor tuned by voltage

say.en: A reverse-biased junction is like a capacitor: the p and n regions are the plates, and the depletion layer is the dielectric between them.
Raise the reverse voltage and the depletion layer widens, like pulling the plates apart. The capacitance falls.
The graph shows C falling as one over the square root of the reverse voltage. This is used for electronic tuning of radios and TVs.
Two more special diodes: the tunnel diode with its negative resistance, and the Schottky diode, a metal–semiconductor junction with a low drop and fast switching.

narration.en: On the board: Varactor: a capacitor tuned by voltage.

body.en: A tunnel diode (Esaki diode) is very heavily doped, so its depletion layer is extremely thin and electrons tunnel through the barrier even at small forward voltages. Its forward characteristic has a peak, then a region where the current falls as the voltage rises (negative resistance), then a valley. It is used in very high-frequency oscillators and fast switches. A Schottky diode is a metal–semiconductor (usually metal–n) junction: it conducts by majority carriers only, has a low forward drop of about 0.2–0.3 V and almost no reverse-recovery time, so it suits high-speed switching and low-voltage power supplies.

points.en: Tunnel: very heavy doping, negative resistance
Schottky: about 0.3 V drop, very fast

narration.en: A tunnel diode is very heavily doped and shows negative resistance. A Schottky diode is a metal–semiconductor junction with a low drop and very fast switching.
narration.kn: ಟನೆಲ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದು ಋಣ ರೋಧ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಶಾಟ್ಕಿ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಲೋಹ-ಅರೆವಾಹಕ ಸಂಧಿ; ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ ಇಳಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ವೇಗದ ಸ್ವಿಚಿಂಗ್.

tryThis.en: With C₀ = 40 pF and V_R = 6.3 V, read C. Check it with the worked example.
Increase V_R. Does the tuned frequency go up or down? Why?
By how much must V_R change to halve the capacitance from its zero-bias value?

problem.en: A varactor has C₀ = 40 pF and V₀ = 0.7 V, with C = C₀/√(1 + V_R/V₀). Find C at V_R = 6.3 V and the resonant frequency with a 100 µH coil.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A varactor has C₀ = 40 pF and V₀ = 0.7 V, with C = C₀/√(1 + V_R/V₀). Find C at V_R = 6.3 V and the resonant frequency with a 100 µH coil.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and picks one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the Karnataka PUC board pattern. Try them on your own before we check.

points.en: Varactor: a reverse-biased diode used as a voltage-variable capacitor.
points.kn: ವ್ಯಾರಾಕ್ಟರ್: ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್-ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಧಾರಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಬಯಾಸ್ ಡಯೋಡ್.

points.en: More reverse voltage → wider depletion layer → smaller capacitance.
points.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ → ಅಗಲ ಸವಕಳಿ ಪದರ → ಕಡಿಮೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ.

points.en: Tunnel diode: very heavy doping and negative resistance.
points.kn: ಟನೆಲ್ ಡಯೋಡ್: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣ ರೋಧ.

points.en: Schottky diode: metal–semiconductor, low drop, fast switching.
points.kn: ಶಾಟ್ಕಿ ಡಯೋಡ್: ಲೋಹ-ಅರೆವಾಹಕ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ, ವೇಗದ ಸ್ವಿಚಿಂಗ್.

homework.en: Draw the symbols of a varactor, a tunnel diode and a Schottky diode, and give one application of each.
Sketch the V–I characteristic of a tunnel diode and mark the peak, valley and negative-resistance region.

narration.en: Recap. Varactor: a reverse-biased diode used as a voltage-variable capacitor. More reverse voltage → wider depletion layer → smaller capacitance. Tunnel diode: very heavy doping and negative resistance. Schottky diode: metal–semiconductor, low drop, fast switching.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವ್ಯಾರಾಕ್ಟರ್: ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್-ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಧಾರಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವ ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ಬಯಾಸ್ ಡಯೋಡ್. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಿಮ್ಮುಖ ವೋಲ್ಟೇಜ್ → ಅಗಲ ಸವಕಳಿ ಪದರ → ಕಡಿಮೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ. ಟನೆಲ್ ಡಯೋಡ್: ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣ ರೋಧ. ಶಾಟ್ಕಿ ಡಯೋಡ್: ಲೋಹ-ಅರೆವಾಹಕ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಳಿಕೆ, ವೇಗದ ಸ್ವಿಚಿಂಗ್.
